stepNotes.1: Plugin namespace loads INTERNAL_PLUGINS [xaiAuthPlugin] plus config plugins (npm pkg@version via BunProc.install, or file:// URLs gated by Filesystem.contains trust check) and fans events via Bus.subscribeAll.
stepNotes.2: Asset is the host shell and code-exec surface; file-URL boundary is Filesystem.contains over Instance.directory/worktree/Global.Path.config; npm path trusts BunProc.install resolution; Env.sanitize strips dangerous env from the $ helper; all init bounded by 15s timeout.
stepNotes.3: Trust-containment check short-circuits before import; failing plugins do not abort siblings (catch+log/publishError); config-hook loop iterates [...hooks] snapshot to allow safe splice; event fanout uses Promise.allSettled so one rejection does not stop others.
stepNotes.4: Startup-only path bounded by PLUGIN_TIMEOUT_MS=15s on init/import/config; event fanout is O(events x hooks) fire-and-forget with no per-call timeout on event handlers (stability note, not perf defect); no unbounded collections.
stepNotes.5: Clean separation of PluginInput capability bag, loader, and trigger runtime; INTERNAL_PLUGINS array is right for built-ins; DEPRECATED_PLUGIN_PACKAGES bare continue is a minor discoverability smell; Instance.state pairs setup with unsubscribe teardown.
stepNotes.6: DEPRECATED_PLUGIN_PACKAGES skip has no log (silent config swallow); npm-install branch lacks dedicated withTimeout; no TODO/empty-catch; the catch->return empty-string->continue install-failure path is logged via Session.publishError so observable.
stepNotes.7: auth-override, plugin-auth-picker, and xai auth-plugin tests cover the internal path; gaps are dedicated negative tests for file-URL trust containment, deprecated-skip, config-hook splice, and Bus.subscribeAll fanout ordering.
stepNotes.8: No findings registered (MODULE-AUDIT: none accepted); no new Critical/High found; observations are hygiene/test-gap notes because the trust-containment check is present and correct; plugin shell access is documented design.
stepNotes.9: AX_TEST_FILES for plugin/auth-override, provider/xai/auth-plugin, cli/plugin-auth-picker plus core typecheck are the proof; full suite skipped per README; no Desktop/SDK/native/script gates apply.
